name: @lunarmoon26/dal
description: Local, human-governed feedback and improvement loop for DeepSeek Harness projects.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p plugins/dal-run-record/tsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/dal-improve-tools/tsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/dal-hmr-candidate/tsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/dal-unknown-effect-guard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p benchmarks/tau-style-workflow/.dsh/plugins/dal-workflow-tools/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/dal-run-record/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/dal-improve-tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/dal-hmr-candidate/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/dal-unknown-effect-guard/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p benchmarks/tau-style-workflow/.dsh/plugins/dal-workflow-tools/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run dal capsule check capsules && pnpm run dal policy check tests/fixtures/guardrail/allowed-read.json --store .dal/check/guardrail && pnpm run dal eval run tests/fixtures/evaluation/v0-suite.json --store .dal/check/evaluations && pnpm run benchmark:check
